name: 双尾飞行结算
description: 在塔尔斯第二个后续己方回合开始时，结算预留搬运。
skillCode: var tails=context.rulePiece;if(!tails||context.playerId!==tails.ownerPlayerId)return {success:false,message:''};var tag=(tails.statusTags||[]).find(function(t){return t.type==='tails-flight-reservation'&&t.ownerId===tails.instanceId;});if(!tag){removeRuleById(tails.instanceId,'rule-tails-flight-resolve');return {success:false,message:''};}tag.turns=(tag.turns||0)-1;if(tag.turns>0)return {success:true,message:'双尾飞行预留还需'+tag.turns+'回合'};var ally=battle.pieces.find(function(p){return p.instanceId===tag.allyId&&p.currentHp>0;});var cells=[{x:tag.x,y:tag.y},{x:tag.allyX,y:tag.allyY}];var occupied=function(cell){return battle.pieces.some(function(p){return p.currentHp>0&&p.instanceId!==tails.instanceId&&p.instanceId!==(ally&&ally.instanceId)&&p.x===cell.x&&p.y===cell.y;});};var legal=cells.every(function(cell){var tile=battle.map.tiles.find(function(t){return t.x===cell.x&&t.y===cell.y;});return tile&&tile.props&&tile.props.walkable&&!occupied(cell);});if(ally&&legal){tails.x=tag.x;tails.y=tag.y;ally.x=tag.allyX;ally.y=tag.allyY;}[tails,ally].filter(Boolean).forEach(function(p){p.statusTags=(p.statusTags||[]).filter(function(t){return t.flightId!==tag.flightId&&t.type!=='immune'&&t.type!=='inoperable';});p.rules=(p.rules||[]).filter(function(r){return r.id!=='rule-tails-flight-resolve'&&r.id!=='rule-tails-flight-immune'&&r.id!=='rule-tails-flight-inoperable';});});if(battle.extensions&&battle.extensions.tileEffects)battle.extensions.tileEffects=battle.extensions.tileEffects.filter(function(e){return e.flightId!==tag.flightId;});removeRuleById(tails.instanceId,'rule-tails-flight-resolve');return {success:true,message:legal&&ally?'双尾飞行完成搬运':'双尾飞行落点失效，搬运取消'};
